title: NBI chief calls alleged threat to VP Duterte's former staff 'tsismis'

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag said the remark from Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp regarding an alleged threat to the life of her former household staff was merely “tsismis” (gossip), as there is no evidence yet to support the claims. Duterte’s legal counsel, Atty. Paolo Panelo, released a statement earlier Tuesday, saying the vice president received a message on Monday evening from a former household staff member asking to be rescued in Manila. The staff member reportedly said they were in the custody of certain individuals who had asked them to sign a document, which […]...
